release_notes: **Dhan rate-limit alerts (429/805) from the dashboard's risk poll**: `/api/risk_summary` is polled every 15s by the dashboard, all night, and each poll REST-quoted every open leg plus an uncached previous-close quote — enough to trip Dhan's 1 req/s limit even with the market closed. It now returns an empty summary outside market hours (same guard as `trade_ltp`), and a successful previous close is cached per underlying per day instead of being re-quoted on every poll.
